verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, a first-party AI agent that lets users investigate logs in natural language instead of writing queries. Users can also ask Loop to build scorers, datasets and dashboards, and Patterns puts Loop to work on the trace backlog on a schedule. Its official MCP server separately lets users query logs, author scorers and run evals through agent clients. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language reaches all product operations (e.g., admin, permissions, deployment configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well Loop works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Loop is Braintrust’s AI agent. It understands your data structure, so you can investigate your logs through natural language instead of writing queries.
Ask Braintrust’s AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
Build datasets from production logs, user feedback, manual curation, or generate them with Loop.
Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
